items.title: Sunday Night Football: Mike Evans active, Dre Greenlaw inactive for 49ers-Vikings
items.text: Evans will play his first game since Oct. 19 on Sunday night in Mexico City.

items.title: Bills can match their best record through 10 games, with a win over Dolphins
items.text: The 8-1 Bills, barring a massive upset, will move to 9-1 today.

items.title: Bills pull off fake punt, extend lead to 6-0
items.text: The Bills reached into their bag of tricks in the first quarter of Sunday's home game against the Dolphins and it paid off for them.

items.title: Jets beat Chargers 27-24 to end five-game losing streak
items.text: The Jets scored on their first five possessions and then ran out the clock on the Chargers from there.

items.title: James Cook goes over 1,000 rushing yards, puts Bills up 20-3
items.text: The Bills were heavy favorites coming into Sunday's game against the Dolphins and they have played like it in the first half.

items.title: Bills lead Dolphins 20-6 at halftime
items.text: The Bills have a big game against the Chiefs on Thanksgiving night, but they haven't gotten caught looking ahead against the Dolphins this Sunday.

items.title: Tyler Bass misses first field goal of season, Bills lead 20-9
items.text: Bills kicker Tyler Bass extended his run of made field goals to open the season to 22 in the first half against the Dolphins on Sunday, but it won't get any longer.

items.title: Bills don't allow a touchdown for third straight game, beat Dolphins 26-9
items.text: The Bills are 9-1 heading into Thursday night's matchup with the Chiefs.

items.title: Travis Kelce moves past Rob Gronkowski for No. 3 all-time in TD catches by a tight end
items.text: For the first time since Sept. 27, Travis Kelce has gotten back into the end zone.

items.title: Cardinals score TD for the first time since Week 8, trail Chiefs 14-7
items.text: For the first time since Week 8, the Cardinals have gotten into the end zone.

items.title: DK Metcalf left locker room without speaking to reporters
items.text: During Sunday's game at Philadelphia, Steelers receiver DK Metcalf was involuntarily sent to the locker room early.

items.title: Travis Kelce has two TDs, Chiefs lead Cardinals 27-7 at halftime
items.text: For the first time since 2022, Travis Kelce has scored multiple touchdowns in a regular-season game.

items.title: Chiefs overwhelm Cardinals, move to 8-2 with 34-7 victory
items.text: Kansas City did not overlook Arizona, setting up a marquee matchup with Buffalo on Thanksgiving Night.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza's second TD pass tied Raiders-Broncos at 17-17
items.text: The Raiders are back in business.

items.title: The Week 11 afternoon schedule is short on must-see games
items.text: As the NFL's haves and the have-nots continue to declare themselves, it's becoming challenging at times to find compelling games.

items.title: Lions open game with missed field goal by Jake Bates
items.text: It's a trap game for the Lions on Sunday against the 3-6 Bucs.

items.title: Lions strike first with touchdown pass from Jared Goff to Amon-Ra St. Brown
items.text: The 7-2 Lions are on the board against the Buccaneers.

items.title: Bucs get on the board to trail Lions 10-7 at half
items.text: The Buccaneers are keeping it close in Detroit, so far.

items.title: Lions stretch lead to 10 with 57-yard touchdown from Jameson Williams
items.text: The Buccaneers had gotten close.

items.title: Lions avoid Tampa Bay trap, move to 8-2
items.text: Detroit sets stage of Thanksgiving showdown vs. 8-2 Bears.

items.title: Bears lead Saints 16-10 at halftime
items.text: The Saints have put some pressure on the Bears, but Chicago still has a 16-7 lead over New Orleans at halftime.

items.title: Jeffery Simmons picks up 3.0 more sacks, Bears beat Saints 21-13
items.text: When the Saints look back on their Week 11 loss to the Bears, they’ll likely lament several missed opportunities.

items.title: Bryce Young sacked for safety, Jacoby Brissett throws TD as Ravens lead Panthers 9-0
items.text: It wasn't a good start for the Panthers today against the Ravens.

items.title: Ravens' Devontez Walker returns kickoff for touchdown in wild game in Carolina
items.text: It's getting crazy in Carolina.

items.title: Panthers come back to beat Ravens in a wild game in Carolina
items.text: In a crazy, back-and-forth game, the Panthers ended up on top, 35-33.

items.title: Derrick Henry cleared after concussion evaluation
items.text: Ravens running back Derrick Henry exited today's game early to get checked for a concussion, but the evaluation provided good news.

items.title: Cowboys, Titans trade early punches in 6-3 game
items.text: The game between the Titans and Cowboys figures to include plenty of points.

items.title: Cowboys stretch lead over Titans to 20-3
items.text: The Cowboys have gotten their act together, which was hardly a guarantee despite facing the one-win Titans.

items.title: Cowboys roll to 27-9 halftime lead over Titans
items.text: The changes to the Dallas defense are working, so far.

items.title: Titans carve into Cowboys lead, trail 27-16
items.text: The Tennessee offense used intermission to snap out of it.
